lineage: Reported as a Conti-linked side operation/spinoff; a member (Deniss Zolotarjovs) was extradited to the US in August 2024
summary: Karakurt is a pure data-theft extortion group that does not encrypt; it steals large volumes of data (often >1 TB of shared drives) and pressures victims with harassment of employees, partners and clients. CISA/FBI advisory AA22-152A (updated December 2023) describes access via purchased VPN/RDP credentials, intrusion brokers, compromised Cisco AnyConnect accounts without MFA, outdated SonicWall/FortiGate appliances, Log4Shell and macro phishing, followed by Cobalt Strike enumeration, Mimikatz, AnyDesk persistence, Ngrok/SSH tunnelling, 7-Zip staging and exfiltration with FileZilla, rclone and Mega.nz.
uniqueTraits: Extortion without encryption: proof-of-life screenshots, proof-of-deletion videos, readme.txt notes and emails to employees
Heavy reliance on purchased credentials and intrusion brokers, including re-extorting victims of other ransomware
Compromised Cisco AnyConnect VPN accounts without MFA as a recurring entry vector
Ngrok and SSH tunnelling for access
Bulk exfiltration (entire shared drives, >1 TB) via rclone to Mega.nz and FileZilla FTP
